steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Priestley's Vision: "An Inspector Calls" argues for exactly these changes. Inspector's final speech - "we are members of one body" - advocates the social solidarity that led to the welfare state. | The Inspector as Socialist Voice: Inspector's final speech is pure socialist message. He argues that privilege brings responsibility, that we must care for each other, that ignoring the vulnerable has consequences. | "An Inspector Calls" - Genre Blend: Starts as realistic drawing-room drama, becomes expressionist. The Inspector seems supernatural. Time is distorted. These theatrical choices make the audience think beyond realism. | Context Must Be Integrated, Not Bolted On: Examiners award AO3 marks for context that is woven into your argument, not dumped in a separate paragraph.
